title: Network Pharmacy Schedule: Claim Correction and Counter Price Terms (Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit)
content:
These terms of the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit govern fills that are not picked up, corrections of a paid claim's member cost share, refunds after a correction, the member's counter price, and manufacturer copay cards.

| | Northbridge Performance Network | Northbridge Essential Network | Northbridge National Network | Northbridge Preferred Savings Network | Northbridge Retail90 Network | Northbridge Open Choice Network |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Return to stock, calendar days after the date of service | 10 | 10 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 |
| Claim reprocessing window, calendar days after the date of service | 90 | 90 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 |
| Pharmacy refund of an overpayment, calendar days after a re-adjudication | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Member pays the lesser of the cost share and the usual and customary price | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Copay card may be billed as secondary payer | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Notes

1. **Return to stock**: a fill not picked up is reversed by the pharmacy after 10 or 14 calendar days from the date of service, as shown for the network.
2. **Claim reprocessing window**: the period after the date of service within which Northbridge Rx may reverse and re-adjudicate a paid claim to correct the member cost share — 90 calendar days on the Northbridge Performance and Essential Networks and 180 calendar days on the other four.
3. **Pharmacy refund**: the network pharmacy refunds the member's overpayment within 30 calendar days after a re-adjudication.
4. **Lesser of**: the member pays the lesser of the computed cost share and the pharmacy's usual and customary cash price.
5. **Copay card**: network pharmacies may bill a manufacturer copay card as secondary payer on a retail claim.
